items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against amended 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated Mon 29 Dec 2025 (posting day, per § 122 Abs. 2 AO cannot be earlier). Deemed delivery for a letter sent by ordinary post from a tax authority occurs on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): 29 Dec 2025 + 4 days = Fri 2 Jan 2026 (not a weekend/holiday in NW, so it stands). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. from 2 Jan 2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Mon 2 Feb 2026. That day is a Monday, not a weekend or NW public holiday, so no further shift applies.
